title: Vintage Harkerware Currier Ives Gold Trim Homestead Winter Plate USA 6.25"
descriptionText:
Vintage Harkerware Currier & Ives "The Old Homestead In Winter" Gold Trim Plate

A classic piece of mid-20th-century American pottery from Harker Pottery
Co., featuring the beloved Currier & Ives winter homestead landscape with
a gold trim border.

- Pattern: Currier & Ives - The Old Homestead In Winter
- Maker: Harkerware (Harker Pottery Co., USA)
- Size: 6 1/4" diameter plate
- Trim: Gold rim
- Era: Mid-20th century

A lovely find for a Currier & Ives collection or vintage farmhouse decor.
Please check photos closely for exact condition - ask any questions before
buying.
